subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3420
title: Requires the Department of Education to transfer from the State School Fund to the Talented and Gifted Education Account an amount that equals one percent of the total amount available to school districts as general purpose grants.
headline: HB 3420 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3420 was introduced in the House on January 28, 2025.
